class.name: ResonanceAudioEffect
class.brief_description: Audio bus effect for reverb output. Auto-configured by ResonanceRuntime.
class.description: ResonanceAudioEffect is an [AudioEffect] that processes the reverb bus. It is added to [member ResonanceRuntimeConfig.reverb_bus_name] when the plugin or [url=#ResonanceRuntime]ResonanceRuntime[/url] initializes. The bus input is the send of every [ResonancePlayer] for the listener reverb. While [member ResonanceListener.apply_reverb] is on, the effect convolves that input once with the reverb simulated at the listener. The output is wet only; the dry signal stays on the players' own buses. For Convolution and TrueAudio Next it also decodes the Steam Audio reflection mixer, which holds the listener reverb and the per-source reflections of players with [member ResonancePlayerConfig.reflections_enabled]. Parametric and Hybrid listener reverb is decoded here directly; their per-source reflections stay in the player output. Adjust [member gain_db] for reverb bus volume. After this bus, Godot routes output to the same target as [method ResonanceRuntimeConfig.get_bus_effective] (runtime [member ResonanceRuntimeConfig.bus]). Until the main thread has prepared the effect (for example right after engine reinit), it outputs silence.

members.member: Volume correction in dB for the reverb bus.
